== Biography == == Trivia == * His ID '''Chovy''' is based on his nickname ''Anchovy''. * His former ID '''ji hun''' stands for his real name (Jeong Ji-hoon). * Became the first professional League of Legends player to achieve a 100 overall KDA in a professional league in January 2019, after a 2-0 victory against [[SK Telecom T1]] in [[LCK 2019 Spring]] brought his overall KDA to 44/1/60. * Awarded Regular Season MVP for [[LCK/2019 Season/Spring Season|LCK 2019 Spring]] and Player of the split for [[LCK/2021 Season/Spring Season|LCK 2021 Spring]] with 1300 and 1000 MVP points respectively. * Occasionally referred to as "Choky" by English fans when he plays poorly. * Sometimes referred to as "8884844" by Korean fans, alluding to his placements at Worlds from 2019 to 2025. * Known for his ability to gather huge minion advantages in lane. * Portrayed as {{ci|Orianna}} in the [[Worlds 2021]] [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Z6CHioIn3s anthem]. * Is one of the four players to appear in the [[Worlds 2022]] [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HYsz1hP0BFo anthem]. * Portrayed as {{ci|Akali}} in the [[Worlds 2024]] [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5FrhtahQiRc anthem]. * His fanbase is referred as the "''Church of Chovy''". * Naturally gifted in playing games. He reached Grandmaster on ''Overwatch'' and was praised by ''VALORANT'' pro-gamer Meteor for his skills. He also enjoys ''PUBG'' and ''Apex Legends''. ** He will sometimes play Tetris on stream and is good at playing the game too. === Statistics === * Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on July 1st, 2021. **Is the 15th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun) | Ghost]], and [[Peanut]] **Was the fastest player (days since debut) in the LCK to achieve 1000 kills before [[ShowMaker]] beat this record 2 months later. **His 1000th kill in the LCK was on [[DRX]]'s ADC [[BAO (Jeong_Hyeon-woo) | BAO]] in the [[LCK 2021 Summer|LCK 2021 Summer Season]] with {{ci|Nocturne}} * Reached 1500 kills in the LCK on February 16th, 2023. ** The 10th player to reach 1500 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], and [[Bdd]]. * Reached 2000 kills in the LCK on April 6th, 2024. ** The 6th player to reach 2000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], and [[Bdd]]. ** His 2000th kill was on [[Hanwha Life Esports|HLE]]'s Support [[Delight]] in the [[LCK/2024 Season/Spring Playoffs|LCK 2024 Summer Playoffs]] with {{ci|Azir}} ** The third mid laner (after [[Faker]], and [[Bdd]]) to reach 2000 LCK kills. * Reached 2500 kills in the LCK on August 20th, 2025. ** The 6th player to reach 2500 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], [[Aiming]] and [[Ruler]]. ** The third mid laner (after [[Faker]], and [[Bdd]]) to reach 2500 LCK kills. * Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on March 6th, 2024. ** Was the 15th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan) | Wolf]], [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[TusiN]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], [[Lehends]], [[Bdd]], [[Keria]], [[Life]], [[BeryL]], [[Canyon]] and [[Cuzz]] * Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on August 30, 2025. ** Was the 13th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK. * Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on March 12th, 2023, becoming the 9th player to do so after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[GorillA]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Peanut]], and [[Bdd]]. ** [[knight (Zhuo Ding)|knight]] got his LPL 300 wins on the same day. * Reached 400 wins in [[LCK]] on June 14th, 2024, becoming the 5th player to do so after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], and Bdd. * Reached 500 wins in LCK on August 30th, 2025, becoming the 3rd player to do so after [[Faker]] and Peanut. * Reached 500 games in the LCK on June 29, 2023, becoming the 10th player to do so, after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[Ruler]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], [[Teddy]], [[Peanut]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], and [[Kiin]]. * Reached 600 games in the LCK on July 11, 2024, becoming the 7th player to do so, after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Bdd]], [[Peanut]], [[Kiin]], and Teddy. * Reached 700 games in the LCK on August 23, 2025, becoming the 6th player to do so, after Faker, Deft, Bdd, Peanut, and Kiin. * Through his first 8 LCK seasons he lost 5 times in the LCK finals and finished in 3rd place twice before finally winning [[LCK 2022 Summer]]. * First player to win 4 LCK titles in a row ([[LCK 2022 Summer]], [[LCK 2023 Spring]], [[LCK 2023 Summer]], and [[LCK 2024 Spring]]) === Individual Awards === * MSI Finals MVP x1 (2025) * LCK Regular Season MVP x4 (Spring 2019, Spring 2024, Summer 2024, LCK 2025) * LCK Player of the Split x3 (Spring 2021, Spring 2024, LCK 2025) * LCK Finals MVP x1 (Summer 2023) * LCK 1st All-Pro Team x4 (Summer 2022, Spring 2024, Summer 2024, LCK 2025) * LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x6 (Spring 2020, Summer 2020, Spring 2021, Spring 2022, Spring 2023, Summer 2023) * LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2021) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results ==
